Listbox

<poad-listbox>

An always visible list of options, to choose one or several: checkboxes, “select all”, filter, groups, and the full keyboard of a list.

Angularrendered by @poadio/ui-angularNext.jsrendered by @poadio/ui-reactReactrendered by @poadio/ui-reactVuerendered by @poadio/ui-vueVanillarendered by @poadio/ui-elements

Form control ([(value)], formControlName); poadListItem, poadListHeader, poadListFooter, poadListEmpty templates.

import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { PoadListboxComponent } from '@poadio/ui-angular';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-listbox-demo',
  imports: [PoadListboxComponent],
  template: `
    <div class="demo-row demo-top">
      <poad-listbox class="demo-list" [options]="teams" [(value)]="team" ariaLabel="Team" />
      <poad-listbox class="demo-list" [options]="regions" [(value)]="picked" multiple filter selectAll listHeight="160px" ariaLabel="Regions" />
    </div>
    <code>team={{ team() }} · regions={{ picked().join(', ') }}</code>
  `,
})
export default class ListboxDemo {
  readonly teams = [{ label: 'Platform', value: 'platform' }, { label: 'Data', value: 'data' }, { label: 'Security', value: 'security', disabled: true }, { label: 'Design', value: 'design' }];
  readonly regions = ['North', 'South', 'East', 'West', 'Île-de-France'];
  readonly team = signal<string | null>('data');
  readonly picked = signal<string[]>([]);
}

Next.js uses the same package as React: the demo is rendered by @poadio/ui-react. The code shows the App Router integration — a client component ('use client') for state, rendered by a server page.

// app/listbox-demo.tsx — client component (state, handlers)
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { PoadListbox } from '@poadio/ui-react';

const teams = [{ label: 'Platform', value: 'platform' }, { label: 'Data', value: 'data' }, { label: 'Security', value: 'security', disabled: true }, { label: 'Design', value: 'design' }];
const regions = ['North', 'South', 'East', 'West', 'Île-de-France'];

export default function ListboxDemo() {
  const [team, setTeam] = useState<unknown>('data');
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<unknown>([]);
  return (
    <>
      <div className="demo-row demo-top">
        <PoadListbox className="demo-list" options={teams} value={team} onValueChange={setTeam} aria-label="Team" />
        <PoadListbox className="demo-list" options={regions} value={picked} onValueChange={setPicked} multiple filter selectAll listHeight="160px" aria-label="Regions" />
      </div>
      <code>team={String(team)} · regions={(picked as string[]).join(', ')}</code>
    </>
  );
}

// app/page.tsx — server component: HTML rendered on the server, hydrated on the client
import ListboxDemo from './listbox-demo';

export default function Page() {
  return <ListboxDemo />;
}

<script type="module">import '@poadio/ui-elements/define';</script>

<div class="demo-row demo-top">
  <poad-listbox id="team" class="demo-list" value='"data"' aria-label="Team"
    options='[{"label":"Platform","value":"platform"},{"label":"Data","value":"data"},{"label":"Security","value":"security","disabled":true},{"label":"Design","value":"design"}]'></poad-listbox>
  <poad-listbox id="regions" class="demo-list" multiple filter select-all list-height="160px" aria-label="Regions"

</div>
<code id="listbox-out">team=data · regions=</code>

<script type="module">
  const team = document.querySelector('#team');
  const regions = document.querySelector('#regions');
  const show = () => { document.querySelector('#listbox-out').textContent = `team=${team.value} · regions=${(regions.value ?? []).join(', ')}`; };
  team.addEventListener('change', show);
  regions.addEventListener('change', show);
</script>

What it is for

When the choices must stay in sight (a few dozen at most). To save space, a select or a multiselect; for two to five choices, radio buttons or a segmented control.

Keyboard

KeyEffect
↓ ↑Next / previous option, skipping disabled ones; with Shift, extends the range in multiple mode.
Home End Page Up Page DownFirst / last option, or eight up / down.
Space EnterChooses the active option (toggle); Space on the “all” box checks or unchecks everything.
aA letter goes to the next option starting with it; Ctrl/⌘+A selects all in multiple mode.

Accessibility

  • Focusable role="listbox", named by aria-label; the active option is designated by aria-activedescendant (focus stays on the list).
  • Options role="option" with aria-selected and aria-disabled; aria-multiselectable in multiple mode; group titles role="presentation".
  • “All” box role="checkbox", aria-checked true, false or mixed; filter field named by its placeholder.
Stylesheets, theme tokens and texts stylesheets to import, 22 tokens, catalogue texts

Stylesheets to import

Nothing to import for this component: it bundles its own sheet (@poadio/ui-core/listbox.css, @poadio/ui-core/icon.css) at build time. Only tokens.css and base.css are loaded once, globally (see Installation).

// app/layout.tsx
import '@poadio/ui-core/tokens.css';          // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/base.css';            // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/listbox.css';         // this component
import '@poadio/ui-core/icon.css';            // this component
// main.tsx
import '@poadio/ui-core/tokens.css';          // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/base.css';            // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/listbox.css';         // this component
import '@poadio/ui-core/icon.css';            // this component
// main.ts
import '@poadio/ui-core/tokens.css';          // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/base.css';            // once, in the global stylesheet
import '@poadio/ui-core/listbox.css';         // this component
import '@poadio/ui-core/icon.css';            // this component

How to change

In the application’s global stylesheet, after the @poadio/ui-core sheets: on :root for the whole application, or on a container for one area only. A floating layer (menu, list, dialog) may be rendered outside its container: for it, prefer :root.

src/styles.css
/* The whole application */
:root {
  --poad-accent: #0b7a5c;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
  --poad-radius: 4px;            /* Corner rounding of controls */
}

/* In dark theme only */
.theme-dark {
  --poad-accent: #3fcf9f;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
}

// app/orderlist-demo.tsx — client component (state, handlers)
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { PoadOrderlist } from '@poadio/ui-react';

interface Step { label: string }
const start: Step[] = [{ label: 'Inspect' }, { label: 'Measure' }, { label: 'Test samples' }, { label: 'Write report' }, { label: 'Review' }];

export default function OrderlistDemo() {
  const [steps, setSteps] = useState<Step[]>(start);
  return (
    <>
      <PoadOrderlist className="demo-order" value={steps} onValueChange={setSteps} header="Steps" filter listHeight="220px" />
      <code>order={steps.map((s) => s.label).join(', ')}</code>
    </>
  );
}

// app/page.tsx — server component: HTML rendered on the server, hydrated on the client
import OrderlistDemo from './orderlist-demo';

export default function Page() {
  return <OrderlistDemo />;
}

What it is for

To arrange a few dozen items at most (steps, columns, priorities). To pick items from one list into another, the pick list; for the order of a table’s rows, the reorderable table.

Keyboard

KeyEffect
↓ ↑ Home EndNext / previous / first / last item; with Shift, extends the selection.
Space EnterChooses the active item (alone); with Ctrl/⌘, adds or removes it. Ctrl/⌘+A chooses all.
Alt ↑Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ move the chosen items up / down one place; Alt+Home / Alt+End send them to the top / bottom.

Accessibility

  • Focusable role="listbox", aria-multiselectable, named by the header (or aria-label), described by the keyboard help; the active item is designated by aria-activedescendant.
  • Named buttons (“Move up”…) in a named group, disabled while nothing can move.
  • Every move (buttons, keyboard, drag) is spoken in an aria-live region: the item’s name and its new position.
  • With a finger, dragging starts from the handle only: the list still scrolls. Under a filter, the shown order is incomplete: no dragging.
  • With a pointer, a preview of the item follows the pointer above the page (a copy hidden from screen readers); the item keeps its place and a line marked with a ring shows where it will go.

import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { PoadPicklistComponent } from '@poadio/ui-angular';

interface Col { label: string }

@Component({
  selector: 'app-picklist-demo',
  imports: [PoadPicklistComponent],
  template: `
    <poad-picklist class="demo-pick" [options]="columns" [(value)]="chosen" sourceHeader="Available" targetHeader="Selected" filter listHeight="200px" />
    <code>export={{ names() }}</code>
  `,
})
export default class PicklistDemo {
  readonly columns: Col[] = ['Service', 'Env', 'Pods', 'Owner', 'Region', 'Notes'].map((label) => ({ label }));
  readonly chosen = signal<Col[]>([this.columns[0]!, this.columns[2]!]);
  names(): string { return this.chosen().map((c) => c.label).join(', '); }

// app/picklist-demo.tsx — client component (state, handlers)
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { PoadPicklist } from '@poadio/ui-react';

interface Col { label: string }
const columns: Col[] = ['Service', 'Env', 'Pods', 'Owner', 'Region', 'Notes'].map((label) => ({ label }));

export default function PicklistDemo() {
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<Col[]>([columns[0]!, columns[2]!]);
  return (

What it is for

To build an ordered selection out of a few dozen options (export columns, team members). For a plain multiple choice, a multiselect or a listbox; to arrange a single list, the order list.

Keyboard

KeyEffect
↓ ↑ Home EndNext / previous / first / last item of the list; with Shift, extends the selection.
SpaceChooses the active item (alone); with Ctrl/⌘, adds or removes it. Ctrl/⌘+A chooses all.
Enter → ←Moves the selection to the other list (no selection: the active item); also Alt+→ from the source, Alt+← from the target.
Alt ↑Alt+↑ / Alt+↓ reorder the selection within its list; Alt+Home / Alt+End send it to the top / bottom.

Accessibility

  • Two multiple role="listbox", named by their titles, described by the keyboard help; the active item through aria-activedescendant.
  • Named transfer buttons (“Add selection”…) in a named group, disabled while nothing can move.
  • Every transfer and every move is spoken in an aria-live region (“Bravo moved to Selected”).
  • Below stackAt px wide, the lists stack and the buttons turn; with a finger the list scrolls, dragging is for the mouse.
  • With a pointer, a preview of the item follows the pointer above the page (a copy hidden from screen readers); the item keeps its place and a line marked with a ring shows where it will go.

How to change

In the application’s global stylesheet, after the @poadio/ui-core sheets: on :root for the whole application, or on a container for one area only. A floating layer (menu, list, dialog) may be rendered outside its container: for it, prefer :root.

src/styles.css
/* The whole application */
:root {
  --poad-accent: #0b7a5c;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
  --poad-radius: 4px;            /* Corner rounding of controls */
}

/* In dark theme only */
.theme-dark {
  --poad-accent: #3fcf9f;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
}

/* One area only */
.checkout {
  --poad-radius: 0;              /* Corner rounding of controls */
}

[(selection)], [(expandedKeys)]; lazy children through loadChildren, or (nodeExpand) then setChildren(key, children); expandAll(), collapseAll(), expandTo(level) methods; poadTreeNode template.

import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { PoadTreeComponent } from '@poadio/ui-angular';

interface Item { id: string; label: string; leaf?: boolean; children?: Item[] }

const file = (id: string, label: string): Item => ({ id, label, leaf: true });
const NODES: Item[] = [
  { id: 'src', label: 'src', children: [
    { id: 'app', label: 'app', children: [file('main', 'main.ts'), file('routes', 'routes.ts')] },
    { id: 'lib', label: 'lib', children: [file('api', 'api.ts'), file('db', 'db.ts')] },
  ] },
  { id: 'docs', label: 'docs', children: [file('readme', 'README.md'), file('guide', 'guide.md')] },
  { id: 'archives', label: 'archives' },
];

@Component({
  selector: 'app-tree-demo',
  imports: [PoadTreeComponent],
  template: `
    <poad-tree class="demo-tree" [value]="nodes" dataKey="id" selectionMode="checkbox" [(selection)]="chosen" [(expandedKeys)]="open"
      filter lazyChildren [loadChildren]="load" [icons]="icon" ariaLabel="Files" />
    <code>selected={{ names() }}</code>
  `,
})
export default class TreeDemo {
  readonly nodes = NODES;
  readonly chosen = signal<Item | Item[] | null>([]);
  readonly open = signal<unknown[]>(['src', 'app']);
  // enfants chargés à la demande (ici, après un court délai)
  readonly load = (row: Item) => new Promise<Item[]>((r) => setTimeout(() => r([file(`${row.id}-2025`, '2025.zip'), file(`${row.id}-2024`, '2024.zip')]), 600));
  readonly icon = (row: Item) => (row.leaf ? 'file' : 'folder');
  names(): string { const s = this.chosen(); return (Array.isArray(s) ? s : s ? [s] : []).map((n) => n.label).join(', ') || '—'; }
}

What it is for

To browse a hierarchy (folders, organisation, categories) or pick nodes in it. With columns, the tree table; to pick a node inside a field, the tree select.

Keyboard

KeyEffect
↓ ↑ Home EndNext / previous / first / last visible node.
→ ←→ expands the node, then moves to its first child; ← collapses it, then moves up to the parent (swapped right to left).
*Expands every sibling node.
Enter SpaceEnter picks the node (a second time removes it); Space ticks its box (checkbox mode) or picks it.
aA letter moves to the next visible node starting with it; letters typed quickly form a word.

Accessibility

  • role="tree" > role="treeitem" with aria-level, aria-setsize, aria-posinset, aria-expanded; a single node in the tab order (roving focus).
  • Picking: aria-selected; boxes: aria-checked on the node (mixed for a partial parent), the drawn box is not a tab stop.
  • The toggle button is for the mouse (“Expand” / “Collapse” tooltip); hidden from screen readers and out of the tab order, → and ← replace it, and the node’s name stays its label alone. While loading, aria-busy and a spinner.

Stylesheets to import

Nothing to import for this component: it bundles its own sheet (@poadio/ui-core/tree.css, @poadio/ui-core/checkbox.css, @poadio/ui-core/icon.css) at build time. Only tokens.css and base.css are loaded once, globally (see Installation).

How to change

In the application’s global stylesheet, after the @poadio/ui-core sheets: on :root for the whole application, or on a container for one area only. A floating layer (menu, list, dialog) may be rendered outside its container: for it, prefer :root.

src/styles.css
/* The whole application */
:root {
  --poad-accent: #0b7a5c;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
  --poad-radius: 4px;            /* Corner rounding of controls */
}

/* In dark theme only */
.theme-dark {
  --poad-accent: #3fcf9f;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
}

/* One area only */
.checkout {
  --poad-radius: 0;              /* Corner rounding of controls */
}
app/globals.css

Org chart

<poad-orgchart>

A hierarchy drawn as connected boxes, top to bottom or left to right: collapsible nodes, picking one or several nodes, zoom, and a keyboard that follows the drawing (parent, children, siblings). On a phone it turns into an indented list.

import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { PoadOrgchartComponent, type PoadOrgNode } from '@poadio/ui-angular';

interface Person { name: string; role: string; initials: string }

const p = (name: string, role: string): Person => ({ name, role, initials: name.split(' ').map((w) => w[0]).join('') });
const ORG: PoadOrgNode<Person>[] = [{
  data: p('Alice Martin', 'Director'), children: [
    { data: p('Bruno Petit', 'Engineering'), children: [{ data: p('Chloé Roux', 'Platform') }, { data: p('David Leroy', 'Apps') }] },
    { data: p('Emma Faure', 'Operations'), children: [{ data: p('Farid Benali', 'Support') }] },
    { data: p('Gaëlle Simon', 'Finance') },
  ],
}];

@Component({
  selector: 'app-orgchart-demo',
  imports: [PoadOrgchartComponent],
  template: `
    <poad-orgchart class="demo-org" [value]="org" labelField="name" sublabelField="role" avatarField="initials" selectionMode="single" [(selection)]="chosen" />
    <code>selected={{ name() }}</code>
  `,
})
export default class OrgchartDemo {
  readonly org = ORG;
  readonly chosen = signal<Person | Person[] | null>(null);
  name(): string { const c = this.chosen(); return (Array.isArray(c) ? c[0] : c)?.name ?? '—'; }
}

Next.js uses the same package as React: the demo is rendered by @poadio/ui-react. The code shows the App Router integration — a client component ('use client') for state, rendered by a server page.

// app/orgchart-demo.tsx — client component (state, handlers)
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { PoadOrgchart, type PoadOrgNode } from '@poadio/ui-react';

interface Person { name: string; role: string; initials: string }

const p = (name: string, role: string): Person => ({ name, role, initials: name.split(' ').map((w) => w[0]).join('') });
const org: PoadOrgNode<Person>[] = [{
  data: p('Alice Martin', 'Director'), children: [
    { data: p('Bruno Petit', 'Engineering'), children: [{ data: p('Chloé Roux', 'Platform') }, { data: p('David Leroy', 'Apps') }] },
    { data: p('Emma Faure', 'Operations'), children: [{ data: p('Farid Benali', 'Support') }] },
    { data: p('Gaëlle Simon', 'Finance') },
  ],
}];

export default function OrgchartDemo() {
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<Person | Person[] | null>(null);
  return (
    <>
      <PoadOrgchart<Person>
        className="demo-org" value={org} labelField="name" sublabelField="role" avatarField="initials" selectionMode="single" selection={chosen} onSelectionChange={setChosen}
      />
      <code>selected={(chosen as Person | null)?.name ?? '—'}</code>
    </>
  );
}

// app/page.tsx — server component: HTML rendered on the server, hydrated on the client
import OrgchartDemo from './orgchart-demo';

export default function Page() {
  return <OrgchartDemo />;
}

What it is for

To show an organisation, a breakdown or a decision tree of a few dozen nodes. To browse a deep hierarchy or tick nodes in it, the tree.

Keyboard

KeyEffect
↓ ↑Top to bottom: ↓ moves to the first child, ↑ to the parent. Left to right: ↑ / ↓ move to the previous / next sibling.
← →Top to bottom: ← / → move to the previous / next sibling. Left to right: → moves to the first child, ← to the parent. Swapped right to left.
Home EndFirst / last visible node. In the compact list, the arrows follow the list as in a tree.
Enter SpacePicks the node (a second time removes it).
+ - *+ expands the node, - collapses it, * expands everything.

Accessibility

  • role="tree" > role="group" > role="treeitem" with aria-level, aria-posinset, aria-setsize, aria-expanded, aria-selected; a single node in the tab order (roving focus).
  • The collapse button is for the mouse (“Collapse” / “Expand” tooltip); hidden from screen readers, + and - replace it. Named zoom buttons in a named group.
  • Wider than its room, the chart scrolls horizontally; below compactAt px (640 by default), it becomes an indented list.

Stylesheets to import

Nothing to import for this component: it bundles its own sheet (@poadio/ui-core/orgchart.css, @poadio/ui-core/avatar.css, @poadio/ui-core/icon.css) at build time. Only tokens.css and base.css are loaded once, globally (see Installation).

import '@poadio/ui-core/avatar.css';          // this component

How to change

In the application’s global stylesheet, after the @poadio/ui-core sheets: on :root for the whole application, or on a container for one area only. A floating layer (menu, list, dialog) may be rendered outside its container: for it, prefer :root.

src/styles.css
/* The whole application */
:root {
  --poad-accent: #0b7a5c;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
  --poad-radius-sm: 2px;         /* Small rounding: list options, small elements */
}

/* In dark theme only */
.theme-dark {
  --poad-accent: #3fcf9f;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
}

/* One area only */
.checkout {
  --poad-radius-sm: 0;           /* Small rounding: list options, small elements */
}

/* The whole application */
:root {
  --poad-accent: #0b7a5c;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
  --poad-radius-sm: 2px;         /* Small rounding: list options, small elements */
}

/* In dark theme only */
.theme-dark {
  --poad-accent: #3fcf9f;        /* Accent colour: primary button, checked box, selection */
}

/* One area only */
.checkout {
  --poad-radius-sm: 0;           /* Small rounding: list options, small elements */
}
